title: Magnitude Phase From Complex Bin
description: A live complex-plane vector driven by real and imaginary sliders, with magnitude and phase formulas worked out numerically alongside the geometry.
creator: Real-Time DSP on a $5 Microcontroller
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Digital Signal Processing
Complex Analysis
Spectrum Display
chapter_title: Computing and Displaying a Real Spectrum

educational.topic: Magnitude and phase of an FFT bin
learningObjectives: Calculate magnitude from real and imaginary parts
Explain why atan2 is required rather than atan

assumptions: A single bin considered in isolation
limitations: Does not show how these values arise from the transform itself

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Paired geometric and algebraic views with live numbers
keyQuestions: Why must phase use atan2 rather than atan?
What information does a magnitude-only spectrum plot discard?
commonMisconceptions: That atan(im/re) is equivalent to atan2(im, re)
That a bin carries a single number
assessmentOpportunities: Compute magnitude and phase for a third-quadrant bin and contrast with atan
